Class LibraryService

java.lang.Object
com.booklibrary.service.LibraryService
public class LibraryService extends Object
Business logic for managing the private book collection. Author: Farid Rahmani Contribution: Implemented the business-logic facade connecting the DAO layer to the JavaFX UI, including the reporting logic. Purpose: the single entry point the UI (controllers) talk to. Holds no SQL itself - it depends only on the DAO interfaces, so the persistence technology can be swapped without changing this class or the UI.

    • searchBooks

      public List<Book> searchBooks(String titleContains, Integer writerId, Integer genreId, Integer bookshelfId, ReadingStatus readingStatus) throws SQLException
      Searches the collection by title, writer, genre, bookshelf and/or reading status. Any parameter left null is not filtered on.
      Parameters:
      titleContains - text that must appear in the title or in the writer's name, or null
      writerId - restrict to this writer's id, or null
      genreId - restrict to this genre's id, or null
      bookshelfId - restrict to this bookshelf's id, or null
      readingStatus - restrict to this reading status, or null
      Returns:
      the list of books matching the given filters
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the underlying query fails
